planets.name: WASP-8 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-8 with a 8.16-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: WASP-8 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around WASP-8. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2010, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 8.1587261, pl_radj 1.13, pl_bmassj 2.54

quotes.title: WASP-8b
quotes.card: WASP-8b is an exoplanet orbiting the star WASP-8A in the constellation of Sculptor.
quotes.introduction: The star is similar to the Sun and forms a binary star with a red dwarf star (WASP-8B) of half the Sun's mass that orbits WASP-8A 4.5 arcseconds away.
